If you wish to mirror ATT with a minimum of issues and replicating the content base structure as identically as possible, here's the required components:

Utterly Essential (if you don't have these, don't bother trying):

  • An SQL or XML dump of the content (get a current revision dump of the content in XML to save space)
  • A LAMP or WAMP stack if mirroring on localhost (XAMPP is a good option) or suitable webhosting with any web service providing MediaWiki installations
  • MediaWiki (1.23+, ideally 1.24 or higher)

Required extensions/skins (If you want all features, scripts, and custom code to work right)

  • Foreground (for some page code, can be omitted)
  • Modern (for some page code, can be omitted)
  • Monaco (for some page code and gadgets, can be omitted) ** This version (https://github.com/Arcane21/monaco-port))
  • MonoBook (for some page code, can be omitted)
  • Vector (Absolutely essential, most page code designed with this in mind)
  • Interwiki (use the InterwikiMagic extension to export our Interwiki map to make it easier to use)
  • PageTriage
  • Babel (need for userboxes)
  • CharInsert (template inserts in Edittools require this)
  • Cite (for adding references)
  • CSS (for Darth/Sugar Wiki code to work right)
  • DPLforum (for our forum namespace)
  • DynamicPageList (for Trope Workshop)
  • EmbedVideo
  • ImageMap
  • InputBox (need for page creation)
  • NoTitle (used on title page}
  • ParserFunctions (essential for many templates to function)
  • Poem (required for site section on poetry, haikus, and quotes to look right)
  • RandomSelection (need for Featured Articles to work properly)
  • RelatedArticles (some pages make use of the functions of this extension)
  • Scribunto (needed for all major templates, most of which use Lua to a considerable degree)
  • Subpage List 3
  • SectionHide
  • SyntaxHighlight (not strictly essential, but is a good idea if you want to tweak the custom CSS/JS pages)
  • Tabber (used for site styling)
  • Tabs (used for site styling)
  • Variables
  • Vote (used for our review pages)
  • Widgets (for video embedding)
  • NativeSvgHandler
  • CodeEditor
  • Disambiguator
  • DismissableSiteNotice
  • Gadgets (not explicitly essential, but many aspects like site spoiler code will work in an extremely degraded manner)
  • LiquidThreads (Used for review pages, site forums, and user talk pages) ** Will be replaced with Flow as soon as it practicable.
  • MultiBoilerplate (for page creation template functionality)
  • NewUserMessage (used for auto welcoming new users)
  • TitleKey
  • WikiEditor (many gadgets require this)
